spans.s: धन् vi. 1P (pres. धनति) To sound.

धन n. 1. Wealth, riches, money, gold, chattels; 2. a valued object, an object of affection, a valued possession, गुरोरपीदं धनमाहिताग्नेः R.ii.44; 3. a valuable article, M.viii.201; 4. capital, (op. to वृद्धि ‘interest’); 5. the reward given to a victor in a combat, the prize won in a game; 6. a contest for prizes, a match; 7. the lunar mansion called धनिष्ठा; 8. the affirmative quantity or plus (in arithmetic), (op. to ऋण).
धान n. A receptacle, a seat.
धाना f. pl. 1. Fried barley or rice; 2. flour of fried barley; 3. corn, grain; 4. a bud, a shoot.
धन-अधिकार m. right to property, right of inheritance.
धन-अधिकारिन्, -अधिकृत m. a treasurer.
धन-अधिकारिन्, -अधिकृत m. a treasurer.
धन-अधिगोप्तृ, -अधिप, -अधिपति, -अध्यक्ष m. 1. an epithet of Kubera, Kir.v.16; 2. a treasurer.
धन-अधिगोप्तृ, -अधिप, -अधिपति, -अध्यक्ष m. 1. an epithet of Kubera, Kir.v.16; 2. a treasurer.
धन-अधिगोप्तृ, -अधिप, -अधिपति, -अध्यक्ष m. 1. an epithet of Kubera, Kir.v.16; 2. a treasurer.
धन-अधिगोप्तृ, -अधिप, -अधिपति, -अध्यक्ष m. 1. an epithet of Kubera, Kir.v.16; 2. a treasurer.
धन-अपहार m. 1. fine; 2. plunder.
धन-अर्चित a. 1. satisfied by valuable presents, मानधना धनार्चिताः Kir.i.19; 2. wealthy, opulent.
धन-अर्थिन् a. wealth-seeking, covetous, miserly.
धन-आढ्य a. wealthy, opulent.
धन-आधार m. a treasury.
धन-ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. a treasurer; 2. an epithet of Kubera.
धन-ईश, -ईश्वर m. 1. a treasurer; 2. an epithet of Kubera.
धन-उष्मन् m. warmth of wealth, power acquired by the possession of wealth. Cf. अर्थोष्मन्.
धन-एषिन् m. a creditor who claims his money.
धन-केलि m. an epithet of Kubera.
धन-गर्व, -गर्वित a. purse-proud.
धन-गर्व, -गर्वित a. purse-proud.
धनंजय m. 1. a name of fire; 2. an epithet of Arjuna, पांचजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनंजयः Bg.i.15.
धन-जात n. all kinds of valuable possessions.
धन-द m. 1. a liberal man; 2. an epithet of Kubera, R.ix.25, xii.52, 88, xvii.80; 3. a name of fire.
धन-द˚अनुज m. an epithet of Rāvaṇa, R.xii.52, 88.
धन-दंड m. punishment in the shape of a fine.
धन-दायिन् m. fire.
धन-पति m. an epithet of Kubera, तत्रागारं धनपतिगृहानुत्तरेणास्मदीयम् Megh.ii.12, i.7.
धन-पाल m. 1. a treasurer; 2. an epithet of Kubera.
धन-पिशाचिका, -पिशाची f. the demon of wealth, e.g. extreme thirst for wealth.
धन-पिशाचिका, -पिशाची f. the demon of wealth, e.g. extreme thirst for wealth.
धन-प्रयोग m. usury.
धन-मूल n. principal, capital.
धन-वत् a. wealthy.
धन-व्यय m. expenditure.
धन-हर m. 1. a thief; 2. a kind of perfume.
धनक m. Avarice, covetousness.
धनाया f. Avarice, covetousness.
धनिक m. 1. A wealthy man; 2. a money-lender, a creditor, कथं धनिका तुलितमस्या भयकारणम् Mrich.ii.; 3. a husband; 4. an honest trader.
धनिका f. 1. A virtuous or excellent woman; 2. a wife; 3. the wife of a wealthy man; 4. a young girl.
धनी f. A young girl.
धनिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Rich, wealthy.
धनिन् (II) m. 1. A wealthy man; 2. a creditor, Yaj.ii.41.
धनिन् (I) a. (f. नी) Rich, wealthy.
धनिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Very rich, (super. of धनिन् or धनवत्).
धनिष्ठ a. (f. ष्ठा) Very rich, (super. of धनिन् or धनवत्).
धनिष्ठा f. Name of the twenty-third lunar mansion consisting of four stars.
धनी f. A young girl.
धानी f. A receptacle, a seat.
धनु m. A bow (perhaps a wrong form of धनुस्).
धनू f. A bow.
धनुस् (I) a. Armed with a bow.
धनुस् (II) n. 1. A bow, R.iii.53, Megh.ii.12; 2. a measure of length equal to four hastas, M.viii.237; 3. an arc of a circle; 4. the sign Sagittarius of the zodiac; 5. a desert.
धनुष्कर (I) a. armed with a bow.
धनुष्कर (II) m. a bow-wmaker.
धनुःकांड n. a bow and arrow.
धनुःखंड n. part of a bow, Megh.i.15.
धनुर्गुण m. a bowstring.
धनुर्ग्रह m. an archer.
धनुर्ज्या f. a bowstring, अनवरतधनुर्ज्यास्फालनक्रूरपूर्वम् Sak.ii.
धनुर्द्रुम m. a bamboo.
धनुर्धर m. an archer, R.ii.11, 29, iii.31, xii.97, xvi.77.
धनुर्धर m. an archer, R.ii.11, 29, iii.31, xii.97, xvi.77.
धनुष्पाणि a. bow-handed.
धनुष्मत् a. armed with a bow, R.vii.56.
धनुर्मार्ग m. a line curved like a bow, a curve.
धनुर्विद्या f. the science of archery.
धनुर्वृक्ष m. 1. a bamboo; 2. the Aśvattha tree.
धनुर्वेद m. that of the four Upavedas which treats of archery. See उपवेद.
धन्य (I) a. (f. न्या) 1. Bestowing wealth, M.iii.106; 2. opulent, wealthy; 3. fortunate, happy, lucky, blessed, धन्या केयं स्थिता ते शिरसि Mud.i.; 4. good, virtuous.

धन्य (II) m. 1. A lucky man, तांबूलीदलपूगपूरितमुखा धन्याः सुखं शेरते Bhartr.i.41; 2. a worthy man, an extraordinary man, धन्यः कोपि न विक्रियां कलयति प्राप्ते नवे यौवने Bhartr.i.72; 3. an infidel, an atheist.
धन्य (III) n. Treasure, wealth.
धन्य (I) a. (f. न्या) 1. Bestowing wealth, M.iii.106; 2. opulent, wealthy; 3. fortunate, happy, lucky, blessed, धन्या केयं स्थिता ते शिरसि Mud.i.; 4. good, virtuous.
धन्या f. A nurse.
धान्य n. Grain, corn; for the distinction between सस्य, धान्य, तंडुल and अन्न, See under तंडुल.
धान्या f. Coriander.
धन्यंमन्य a. considering oneself happy or fortunate.
धन्य-वाद m. thanks-giving, thanks, praise, applause.
धन्याक n. 1. A plant bearing a small pungent seed used as a condiment; 2. the seed of this plant.
धान्याक n. Coriander.
धन्व n. A bow (rarely met with in classics).
धन्व-धि m. a bow-case.
धन्वन् (I) n. A substitute for धनुस् at the end of Bahu. compounds, अधिज्यधन्वा विचचार दावम् R.ii.8.
धन्वन् (II) m.n. A dry soil, a desert, a waste, एवं धन्वनि चंपकस्य सकले संहारहेतावपि Bh.V.i.31.
धन्वन्-दुर्ग n. a fort inaccessible on account of surrounding desert.
धन्वंतर n. A measure of length equal to four hastas, (the same as दंड q.v.).
धन्वंतरि m. Name of the physician of the gods. (He was produced at the churning of the ocean with a cup of nectar in his hand.)
धन्विन् (I) a. (f. नी) Armed with a bow.
धन्विन् (II) m. 1. An archer, के मम धन्विनोऽन्ये K.S.iii.10, आकर्णकृष्टमपि कामितया स धन्वी R.ix.57; 2. an epithet of Arjuna; 3. of Śiva; 4. of Viṣṇu; 5. the sign Sagittarius of the zodiac.
धन्विन् (I) a. (f. नी) Armed with a bow.
धन्विन m. A hog.
धानुर्दंडिक m. An archer, निमित्तादपराद्धेषोर्धानुष्कस्येव वल्गितम् Sis.ii.27.
धानुर्दंडिक m. An archer, निमित्तादपराद्धेषोर्धानुष्कस्येव वल्गितम् Sis.ii.27.
धानुष्य m. Bamboo.
धांधा f. Cardamoms.
धान्य-अर्थ m. wealth in grain.
धान्य-अम्ल n. sour gruel made of the fermentation of rice-water.
धान्य-अस्थि n. husk, chaff.
धान्य-उत्तम m. the best of grain, i.e. rice.
धान्य-कल्क n. chaff, straw.
धान्य-कोश m. a granary.
धान्य-कोष्ठक n. a granary.
धान्य-क्षेत्र n. a corn-field.
धान्य-चमस m. rice flattened by threshing after it has been fried in the husk.
धान्य-त्वच् f. the husk of corn.
धान्य-माय m. a dealer in corn.
धान्य-राज m. barley.
धान्य-वर्धन n. lending grain at interest, usury with grain.
धान्य-वीर m. a sort of pulse (माष).
धान्य-शीर्षक n. an ear of corn.
धान्य-शूक n. the beard of corn.
धान्य-सार m. threshed corn.
धान्वन a. (f. नी) Situated in a desert.
धान्वन a. (f. नी) Situated in a desert.
